connector.name: Priceparse
connector.registryDescription: Extract structured pricing tiers and addons from any SaaS pricing page URL. Built for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.priceparse.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the larshiensch99 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your-api-key>. Get a free key at https://priceparse.com — 100 extractions/month, no credit card.
